fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 12660 Old Virginia Rd, Reno NV 89521 in the Damonte Ranch industrial park, alongside I-580/US-395. Single ~601K sq ft DC building. Address verified via Panjiva, Chamber of Commerce, and Facebook (Barnes & Noble Reno Distribution Center).
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED via Street View (2022 and 2025 panos): a yellow-and-white striped barrier arm spans the entrance driveway lane, flanked by yellow protective bollards, with a STOP sign. The 2015 pano shows the same driveway WITHOUT the arm, so the barrier was installed after 2015. High confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere at the entrance in any Street View pano (2015/2022/2025) or satellite imagery. The barrier arm stands alone with no adjacent staffed structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Barrier-arm truck gate with no guard booth implies badge/card or remote/app check-in; remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous bank of loading-dock doors along the SOUTH building face; roughly 20+ trailers visible backed in. Roof glare in satellite limits an exact count; estimated ~38 doors, 25-50 band. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of trailer parking south of the dock apron holds dropped trailers; estimated 10-25 band. Not a large dedicated drop lot, so dropYard flag left false.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Long paved driveway approach between the public road and the barrier arm provides room for trucks to wait before the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide dock apron inside the gate before the dock doors provides interior staging room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach plus the wide apron easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Damonte Ranch is a master-planned suburban district of south Reno with dense surrounding development - apartment complexes immediately north, multiple warehouses adjacent, and the I-580 freeway. Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Several large warehouses surround the site but they are separate properties; the B&N facility is a single building.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the nearest rail is not adjacent. Not rail-served.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared entrance driveway with the barrier arm; estimated 1 in / 1 out, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 22 trailers counted at the south docks and in the trailer-parking row; honest overhead estimate.
